# Bicker Table Advisory

> I'm an AI Systems Architect for organizations that run on people. I help established schools and service businesses in the US and UK move from staff using AI on their own to AI that works across the operation with people directing it.

Bicker Table Advisory is the trade name of TBT Advisory LLC, Palm Desert, California.
Founder: Jamie Arias (she/her), founder and AI Systems Architect. She is the sole founder.
Contact: jamie.arias@bickertable.com

Campaign: From Using AI to Operating with AI.
Thesis: Individual AI productivity is not organizational intelligence.

The first conversation is a 15 to 20 minute pre-assessment, also called From Using AI to Operating with AI.
In 15 to 20 minutes, Jamie looks at how a team is using AI today and where it could create the most value next.
The leader leaves with a clear picture of their starting point and one practical next step. No pitch, no prep.

- Book: https://bickertable.com/book/
- Calendar: https://calendar.app.google/b1x45zqXGBStd7sQ6

## Audiences

- Owners and CEOs of established service businesses in the US and UK, about 20 to 250 people: https://bickertable.com/businesses/
- Heads of independent, private, and charter schools, and leaders of UK academy trusts: https://bickertable.com/schools/

## Opportunity Brief

https://bickertable.com/opportunity-brief/
The Agentic AI Opportunity Brief is the discovery Jamie uses when the pre-assessment shows a reason to go further.
It is an early look at the operation, in fifteen named parts, business first. It is not a technical audit and not an implementation specification.

## Insights

Series: From Using AI to Operating with AI. Tuesday essays are for service-business owners. A Wednesday series for school leaders is planned. The site is the canonical home for the essays.
Index: https://bickertable.com/insights/

- Week 1, Your Team's ChatGPT Habits Are Your Real Operating Manual: staff using AI on their own is not the same as an organization that keeps what it learns. https://bickertable.com/insights/your-teams-chatgpt-habits/
- Week 2, Your AI Starting Point Depends on Which Door You Open: each part of a business has its own starting point with AI. https://bickertable.com/insights/which-door-you-open/

## About

https://bickertable.com/about/
Jamie Arias, founder and AI Systems Architect. Ten years teaching (K-12, adults, Title I middle grades). Twenty years in sales, including digital marketing for home health and real estate. Three prompt-engineering and auditing projects with major AI companies, two with Google and one with Meta. Bilingual in English and Spanish. Palm Desert, California.

## AI Starting Point check

https://bickertable.com/starting-point/
A free check of about three minutes. No login, no email, and nothing is stored or sent. The visitor chooses a business path or a school path, answers 11 questions, and sees one of three starting pictures: Individual Experiments, Pockets of Practice, or Ready to Operate with AI. It is a quick self-check, not an audit or compliance review. It leads to the 15 to 20 minute call: https://bickertable.com/book/
